meta.title: ABLE — Work that fits you
meta.description: ABLE connects job seekers with disabilities to employers who want to hire them — with profiles that show real skills, AI matching, and built-in chat, voice and video calls.

styleguide.title: ABLE design system
styleguide.intro: Tokens and components used across ABLE.
styleguide.dialogBody: Dialogs drop in from above and trap focus until closed.
styleguide.sheetBody: Sheets slide up from the bottom. Drag the handle down to close.
styleguide.nameHint: Use the name employers will see.
styleguide.bioPlaceholder: A few sentences about what you do best
styleguide.skillsPlaceholder: Type a skill and press Enter
styleguide.switchLabel: Show my age on my profile
styleguide.tabAText: Posts content slides in from the side of the selected tab.
styleguide.faqQ: Do I have to say I have a disability?
styleguide.faqA: No. Anything about your work setup is optional and private unless you choose to share it.
styleguide.typeBody: Body text sits at 16px with a 1.6 line height and never runs longer than 72 characters, so long reading stays comfortable on every screen.
styleguide.emptyBody: Star people from your feed and they’ll appear here.

onboard.title: Build your profile
onboard.saveFailed: Couldn’t save. Check your connection and try again.
onboard.voiceBody: Speak for up to 2 minutes about your work, skills and studies. AI drafts each field and you review it.
onboard.photoHint: A clear photo helps employers recognise you. You can skip this.
onboard.displayNameHint: How your name appears on your profile.
onboard.handleTaken: That link is taken. Try another.
onboard.handleFormat: Use 3–30 lowercase letters, numbers or hyphens.
onboard.dobHint: Private. Only used to show your age if you turn it on.
onboard.showAge: Show my age on my profile
onboard.genderHint: Private. Never shown on your profile and never used to filter or rank you.
onboard.headline: Headline
onboard.bioPlaceholder: What do you do best? What kind of work are you looking for?
onboard.skillsPlaceholder: Type a skill and press Enter
onboard.certHint: Upload a PDF or image, up to 10 MB.
onboard.contactsHint: Choose who can see each one. By default, only employers you chat with see your details.
onboard.workSetupHint: Optional and private. For example “screen reader”, “remote work” or “flexible hours”. Hidden from everyone until you choose to share it with a specific employer.
onboard.workSetupPlaceholder: Describe anything that helps you do your best work
onboard.consentAi: Let ABLE send my voice and text to AI providers to fill fields, write drafts and match me with jobs. Voice recordings are deleted right after transcription.
onboard.consentWorkSetup: Let ABLE store my “Work setup I need” note. It stays private.

ai.consentTitle: Use AI to help fill this in?
ai.consentBody: Your voice or text is sent to OpenAI (speech to text) and Anthropic (writing help) to create suggestions for you. Recordings are deleted right after they’re turned into text. You can turn this off anytime in Settings.
ai.listening: Listening. Tap stop when you’re done.
ai.checkIt: check it, then keep or edit

voiceFill.title: Fill my profile by voice
voiceFill.body: Talk for up to 2 minutes about your work, skills and studies. AI drafts the fields, and you check each one.
voiceFill.introLead: Speak naturally in Thai or English. It helps to mention:
voiceFill.tip1: Your name and what people call you
voiceFill.tip2: The kind of work you want
voiceFill.privateNote: We never fill your date of birth, gender, contact details or work setup from what you say. Recordings aren’t kept.
voiceFill.recordingHint: Take your time. Tap stop when you’re finished.
voiceFill.typePlaceholder: For example: I’m Ploy from Chiang Mai. I studied accounting and I’ve done customer support by chat for two years…
voiceFill.typeHint: A few sentences is enough. AI turns them into fields for you to check.
voiceFill.working: Sorting what you said into fields…
voiceFill.nothingFound: We couldn’t find profile details in that. Try mentioning your skills or the work you want.
voiceFill.ready: {count, plural, one {# field is} other {# fields are}} ready to review
voiceFill.reviewLead: Untick anything you don’t want, and edit any wording. Nothing is added until you confirm.
voiceFill.apply: {count, plural, =0 {Choose fields to add} one {Add # field to my profile} other {Add # fields to my profile}}
voiceFill.applied: {count, plural, one {Added # field.} other {Added # fields.}} Check each step before you finish.
